faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB) based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, for one Junior Research Fellow position under an IARC-WHO project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for RGCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post under this notification is Junior Research Fellow. There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for this temporary research position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RGCB JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed online applications is 14-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they submit their applications before this deadline to be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate degree in any branch of Life Sciences along with national level qualifications such as CSIR-UGC NET, DBT-BET, or GATE, alongside relevant research familiarity.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is set at 28 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary/stipend offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of ₹ 37,000/- plus 18% HRA as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official portal. Offline applications or submissions through other unprescribed modes will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by the Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology for this post.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for this position?
faq.answer: Applicants are initially shortlisted based on eligibility criteria, followed by a final selection made through an online selection interview assessing qualifications and performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and online application links are available on the official RGCB website and through the Important Links section of this article.
